label: rem:skein-archimedean-shadow
title: Skein relations as an archimedean shadow
html: In the archimedean realisation, the Markov trace on the braid-group representation yields the Jones polynomial. The Skein relation corresponds to the trace of the characteristic equation of the braiding c_{V,V} (R-matrix braiding). Over \mathbb{Q}_\mathfrak{p}, the same characteristic equation holds (because the eigenvalues q and -q^{-1} are elements of the base ring), but no ambient 3-manifold exists in which to interpret it as a knot invariant. The categorical formulation of the braid action on tensor products therefore captures the algebraic content of braiding without presupposing an archimedean topology.
